_what: STEP 1 FAN-OUT — cmpd19 congeneric relative binding free-energy map (RUNG 4, tranche 1)
_scope: 19 map edges at their charge-conserving microstate leg, on the PRIMARY nr4a3_design druggable frame. Charge-changing microstate legs and the conformer/paralogue frame axis are separate tranches and were NOT run — see congeneric_fanout.plan().
_claim_ceiling: CONDITIONAL relative free energies given a HYPOTHESIZED cmpd19 pose (no solved NR4A3 cocrystal) in ONE modeled opened conformer, single replicate per edge. NOT affinities, NOT a selectivity readout, NOT a sensitivity range. Accuracy is not established here — it rests on valA_mini + OpenFE's published benchmark for this protocol.

e_zaienne_cmpd19__cw_bio_nmethyl_amide__.why: no available mapper reaches the provable atom-map floor of 20. LOMAP element_change=False 17; element_change=True 19, but ONLY by mapping the ester methyl CARBON onto an amide HYDROGEN (C->H), which is the degenerate correspondence the floor exists to reject; Kartograf 18. Identical maps at LOMAP budgets t20 and t300 in 0.01 s, so the MCS timeout is MEASURED not to be the mechanism. This is a statement about the MAPPERS, not about any rented host, so no rental can fix it. A complete 22-atom map provably exists (the heavy-atom graphs are isomorphic up to the single O->N substitution), so the block is revisitable: if a mapper ever returns >= 20 for this edge, lift it with FANOUT_UNBLOCK=1.
e_zaienne_cmpd19__cw_bio_nmethyl_amide__.evidence: research/modalities/step1-map-diag.json row zaienne_cmpd19->cw_bio_nmethyl_amide (verdict MAPPER_CANNOT_REACH_FLOOR, measured 2026-07-28 on the production staged components, with the per-mapper unmapped-atom and element-change detail); narrative in research/modalities/step1-fanout-lane.md section 7c
